config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.gem]
dialect = "gemini"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "gem-secret"
session_header = "x-affinity"
session_missing = "reject"


[[models]]
name = "gem-flash"
provider = "gem"
model = "gemini-2.0-flash"
name: m4_session_missing_reject_gemini
